title: Ruuh buy wottu ci wetu dex gi
intro: Dañu dénk benn xale bu ndaw liggéey bu nëbbu, mu xool fu sori, di xool li xew ci ndox mi. Limu nit ñi gisu ñu ko, te kenn xamul lumuy tekki, dina def lu am solo ci soppi taarixu benn réew.
clues: Sama yaay daf ma jox benn liggéey, muy liggéey buma wara nëbb ba noppi di xool bu baax.
Samay bët topp berso bu ndaw buy daw ci ndox mi, sama xol diis ndax jaaxle.
Bi ñu ko gisee ci mbooloo muma xamul woon, ma jegesi, fees dell ak tiitaange.
Gis naa ni ñu ñàkka am ku leen di toppatoo ba noppi ma wax leen saafara te waxuma dëgg gi.
Lima def ci jamono jooju, indiwaat ruuh buy dundal ki ko gënoon soxla.
Ci biir këru boroom doole yi, ma wax leen: 'Ndax ma yóbbu leen ci famiy bu koy dundal, diko toppatoo bu baax?'

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
